inputs.text: Provisional visual concept only for Kip, an original weaponized toy racing car. Single low, compact, wide racing car with a simple molded-plastic body, four individually visible rubber wheels with clear gaps from the chassis, a small removable-looking toy launcher above the rear, no humanoid features. Warm red and cream panels are a temporary color study, not approved canon. Three-quarter front view, entire car centered and isolated against a plain white studio background, soft product photography lighting, crisp silhouette, realistic small toy materials, no people, no scenery, no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra vehicles.
